        checked = self.m_checkList1.GetCheckedItems()
        labels = [self.m_checkList1.GetString(i) for i in checked]

        self.on_generate_callback(labels)

    def OnCheck(self, event):
        idx = event.GetInt()                 # which item was clicked
        label = self.m_checkList1.GetString(idx)

        if label == "All":
            is_checked = self.m_checkList1.IsChecked(idx)

            # For all items *except* "All", set their check state to match
            count = self.m_checkList1.GetCount()
            for i in range(count - 1):       # last item is "All"
                self.m_checkList1.Check(i, is_checked)

        event.Skip()
